name: testrail-cli
description: Small TestRail CLI for humans and agents

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/cli.js --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __bundleRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bundleRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/index.ts --platform=node --format=esm --target=node16 --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=warning
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
